version_section: 7.0.10-61; commit eeb41d70c9baf418a3aa75c424fb305362a1b280; L766–790 brightness-contrast; L874–920 channel; L1961–1967 deskew; L2231–2243 Perspective; L2479–2496 distort canvas; L5381–5402 normalize; L6236–6239 separate; L6498–6508 size; L6870–6907 threshold
observed: brightness/contrast is a relative linear transformation, not a QR decoder. Perspective needs four coordinate pairs and preserves straight lines. -distort defaults to the input-size canvas; +distort fits the transformed image; viewport can override. threshold's raw quantum count differs from a percent. size is an input/canvas hint, not a resize of an already read image. normalize documentation identifies contrast-stretch 2%x1%.
claim_relation: Supports different arguments/stages despite the same product; refutes interpreting every deskew/perspective operation as the same action. The normalize alias claim is contradicted by the same release's enhance.c implementation.
limitations: 7.0.10-61 is the stated version only for IM-A2. Other request versions are unspecified. Function documentation does not establish original QR decoding, automatic corners or wrapper API correctness. Multiple anchors count once.

version_section: 7.0.10-61; commit eeb41d70c9baf418a3aa75c424fb305362a1b280; L561–581 Image Stack / parentheses
observed: Parentheses create a separate image stack; operators inside apply to that stack. Unix escaping belongs to shell token construction, while parentheses must be separate command arguments.
claim_relation: Supports the significance of the grouped clone/mask pipeline and the need to compare actual arguments rather than program name or visually similar strings.
limitations: Does not establish QuickMagick/RMagick translation correctness or repair a shell fragment. Root probe separately observes literal expansion and synthetic CLI behavior.

version_section: 7.0.10-61; commit eeb41d70c9baf418a3aa75c424fb305362a1b280; L1900–1920 brightness-contrast; L2125–2147 contrast-stretch percent parsing; L2242–2278 distort / IsPlusOp; L2947–2949 normalize
observed: CLI dispatch parses brightness/contrast values and passes them to BrightnessContrastImage; contrast-stretch converts percentages to image-pixel counts and computes the white-side complement; the sign of distort is passed as bestfit; normalize dispatches to NormalizeImage.
claim_relation: Connects documented option text with the implementation, distinguishing named aliases and effect-changing operator signs.
limitations: Static implementation reading, not an execution of 7.0.10-61. Parsing existence does not prove source-image goal satisfaction.

version_section: 7.0.10-61; commit eeb41d70c9baf418a3aa75c424fb305362a1b280; L828+ Perspective mapping; L1678–1696 contract; L1818–1822 default canvas; L1882–1905 bestfit corners; L2018–2026 bounds; L2031–2038 viewport override
observed: Perspective uses a projective mapping. Default output canvas starts at input dimensions with zero offset; bestfit derives transformed bounds; an explicit viewport replaces the computed geometry.
claim_relation: Supports a real +distort/-distort canvas difference and a countercase where explicit viewport makes those two spellings equivalent on a fixed input.
limitations: No automatic source-corner detector or curved-surface dewarping is established. A source photograph's correct physical aspect ratio cannot be inferred solely from this mapping code.

version_section: 7.0.10-61; commit eeb41d70c9baf418a3aa75c424fb305362a1b280; L222–251 BrightnessContrastImage; L1551+ ContrastStretchImage and L1660–1674 histogram limits; L4096–4105 NormalizeImage
observed: BrightnessContrastImage derives a linear slope from contrast. In fixed 7.0.10-61 NormalizeImage uses black=count*0.0015 and white=count*0.9995, corresponding through the CLI parser to 0.15% low and 0.05% high clipping. This differs from the same tag's 2%/1% documentation.
claim_relation: Refutes an unqualified cross-version normalize=contrast-stretch 2%x1% alias. Supports separating source-confirmed old defaults from research-version results.
limitations: Old release was not compiled or run. These are implementation values, not a historical user's runtime receipt or original QR decoder result.

version_section: 7.0.10-61; commit eeb41d70c9baf418a3aa75c424fb305362a1b280; L28–38 rose: average input; L59–67 expected/reference pixels; L98–119 19 color-space checks
observed: Upstream test constructs the rose: average, expects 146,89,80 (with alternative gamma error colors 73,26,21 and 199,160,152), and checks color-space round trips. The unchanged fixed script was executed against research ImageMagick 7.1.1-43 and passed 19/19 TAP checks.
claim_relation: Supports color-space conversion as an independently tested stage; provides an upstream input/expected-output bundle. Research receipt: probes/results.json upstream_script_execution.
limitations: This test does not implement the HCL/G/15%-mask wrapper pipeline and does not validate the original grayscale-removal image. The script is from 7.0.10-61 but the executed binary is 7.1.1-43. The test's failure-message text says 145 while the expected comparison is 146; recorded values follow the comparison.
